source.text: וַיַּ֨עַשׂ יֹאשִׁיָּ֧הוּ בִֽירוּשָׁלִַ֛ם פֶּ֖סַח לַיהוָ֑ה וַיִּשְׁחֲט֣וּ הַפֶּ֔סַח בְּאַרְבָּעָ֥ה עָשָׂ֖ר לַחֹ֥דֶשׁ הָרִאשֽׁוֹן׃

records.literal_gloss: And kept Josiah in Jerusalem [a] Passover to Yahweh, and they slaughtered the Passover on [the] fourteenth [day] of the month the first.

en.L: And Josiah kept a Passover to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem, and they slaughtered the Passover [lamb] on the fourteenth [day] of the first month.
en.B: Josiah kept a Passover to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} in Jerusalem. They slaughtered the Passover lamb on the fourteenth day of the first month.
en.R: Josiah celebrated the Passover in Jerusalem to honor {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. The Passover lambs were killed on the fourteenth day of the first month.

es.L: Y Josías celebró la Pascua {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Jerusalén, y degollaron la Pascua [el cordero] el día catorce del mes primero.
es.B: Josías celebró la Pascua {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} en Jerusalén. Degollaron el cordero de la Pascua el día catorce del mes primero.
es.R: Josías celebró la Pascua en Jerusalén en honor {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Los corderos de la Pascua se mataron el día catorce del mes primero.

fr.L: Et Josias célébra à Jérusalem une Pâque {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et on égorgea la Pâque le quatorzième [jour] du premier mois.
fr.B: Josias célébra à Jérusalem une Pâque en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. On égorgea l’agneau de la Pâque le quatorzième jour du premier mois.
fr.R: Josias a célébré la Pâque à Jérusalem en l’honneur {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. On a tué les agneaux de la Pâque le quatorzième jour du premier mois.

sw.L: Naye Yosia akamfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Pasaka huko Yerusalemu, nao wakamchinja [mwana-kondoo wa] Pasaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza.
sw.B: Yosia alimfanyia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Pasaka huko Yerusalemu. Walimchinja mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza.
sw.R: Yosia alisherehekea Pasaka huko Yerusalemu kwa heshima ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Wana-kondoo wa Pasaka walichinjwa siku ya kumi na nne ya mwezi wa kwanza.

vi.L: Giô-si-a giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem, và người ta giết [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ nhất.
vi.B: Giô-si-a giữ Lễ Vượt Qua cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} tại Giê-ru-sa-lem. Người ta giết chiên Lễ Vượt Qua vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ nhất.
vi.R: Giô-si-a mừng Lễ Vượt Qua tại Giê-ru-sa-lem để tôn vinh {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua được giết vào ngày mười bốn tháng thứ nhất.

ko.L: 그리고 요시야가 예루살렘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지켰다. 그리고 그들이 첫째 달 열나흗날에 유월절 [양을] 잡았다.
ko.B: 요시야는 예루살렘에서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 유월절을 지켰다. 그들은 첫째 달 열나흗날에 유월절 양을 잡았다.
ko.R: 요시야는 예루살렘에서 유월절을 지키며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 영광을 돌렸다. 유월절 양들은 첫째 달 열나흗날에 잡았다.

pt.L: E Josias celebrou em Jerusalém uma Páscoa {{divine_name:para o SENHOR|para Javé}}, e abateram a Páscoa no [dia] catorze do primeiro mês.
pt.B: Josias celebrou em Jerusalém uma Páscoa {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}. Abateram o cordeiro da Páscoa no dia catorze do primeiro mês.
pt.R: Josias celebrou a Páscoa em Jerusalém em honra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Os cordeiros da Páscoa foram mortos no dia catorze do primeiro mês.

decisions.choice: the Passover of 2 Kings 23:21-23, told at length
decisions.reason: 2 Kings 23:21-23 gives this Passover in three verses: the king's command to keep it "as it is written in this book of the covenant", the statement that none like it had been kept, and the date. Chronicles opens with the bare statement that Josiah kept it, tells the whole festival (verses 2-17), and then closes with the other two parts (verses 18-19). The words that match Kings are given the same wording here.

decisions.choice: the fourteenth day of the first month: the date the law sets
decisions.reason: The law sets the Passover on the fourteenth day of the first month, at evening (Exodus 12:6; Leviticus 23:5; Numbers 9:3). Hezekiah's Passover had to be held a month late, in the second month, because not enough priests were ready (30:2-3, 15). Josiah's is kept on the proper date.

decisions.choice: the Passover: the Passover animal
decisions.reason: The word names the festival in the first half of the verse and the animal killed for it in the second. The animal was a lamb or a young goat (Exodus 12:5; verse 7).

decisions.choice: [lamb] (Literal); lamb (Balanced, Readable); celebrated ... to honor (Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal brackets "lamb", which the Hebrew leaves to the word "Passover"; Balanced and Readable say it. Readable says "celebrated ... to honor" for keeping a feast to the LORD, as at 2 Kings 23:21.

decisions.choice: "[el cordero]" (L); "el cordero de la Pascua" (B); "los corderos de la Pascua" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew lets "Passover" name the animal (m3); Literal brackets the lamb and Balanced and Readable say it, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "on égorgea la Pâque" at Literal
decisions.reason: French "la Pâque" can name the Passover animal, as in Exodus 12:21, so Literal needs no bracket where the English supplies "[lamb]"; Balanced and Readable say "l'agneau".

decisions.choice: "[chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua" (L); "chiên Lễ Vượt Qua" (B); "chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "the Passover" here is the animal (m3); Vietnamese names it, bracketed at Literal as the English does.

decisions.choice: celebrou ... uma Páscoa para o SENHOR (L), ao SENHOR (B), em honra do SENHOR (R); abateram a Páscoa (L), o cordeiro da Páscoa (B), os cordeiros da Páscoa (R)
decisions.reason: Josiah's Passover keeps the words 2 Kings 23:21 gives it in Portuguese at each level (m1), "a Páscoa" as Exodus 12:11, with "celebrar" for keeping a feast. For the animal (m3), Literal keeps "a Páscoa" and Balanced and Readable name the lamb, as 30:15 does in Portuguese; the date is written as there, "no dia catorze" (m2).

source.text: וַיַּעֲמֵ֥ד הַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים עַל־מִשְׁמְרוֹתָ֑ם וַֽיְחַזְּקֵ֔ם לַעֲבוֹדַ֖ת בֵּ֥ית יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And he appointed the priests over their duties, and he strengthened them for [the] service of [the] house of Yahweh.

en.L: And he set the priests over their duties and strengthened them for the service of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: He put the priests at their posts and urged them on in the service of the house of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: He gave the priests their duties and encouraged them to do their work in the temple of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.

es.L: Y puso a los sacerdotes en sus funciones, y los animó para el servicio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Puso a los sacerdotes en sus puestos y los animó en el servicio de la casa {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Les dio a los sacerdotes sus tareas y los animó a hacer su trabajo en el templo {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.

fr.L: Et il établit les prêtres dans leurs fonctions et les affermit pour le service de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Il installa les prêtres à leurs postes et les encouragea dans le service de la maison {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Il a donné aux prêtres leurs tâches et il les a encouragés à faire leur travail dans le temple {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.

sw.L: Akawaweka makuhani katika zamu zao, akawatia nguvu kwa ajili ya huduma ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Aliwaweka makuhani katika nafasi zao, akawatia moyo katika huduma ya nyumba ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Aliwapa makuhani kazi zao, akawatia moyo wafanye kazi yao katika hekalu la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.

vi.L: Vua đặt các thầy tế lễ vào chức vụ của họ và khích lệ họ trong việc phục vụ nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Vua đặt các thầy tế lễ vào vị trí của họ và khích lệ họ phục vụ trong nhà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Vua giao nhiệm vụ cho các thầy tế lễ và khích lệ họ làm công việc của mình trong đền thờ của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 제사장들을 그들의 직무에 세우고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집을 섬기는 일에 그들을 격려했다.
ko.B: 그는 제사장들을 각자 맡은 자리에 세우고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 집에서 섬기는 일을 잘하도록 격려했다.
ko.R: 그는 제사장들에게 각자 할 일을 맡기고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 성전에서 일을 잘하도록 격려했다.

pt.L: E pôs os sacerdotes nos seus cargos e os fortaleceu para o serviço da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Ele pôs os sacerdotes nos seus postos e os animou no serviço da casa {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Ele deu aos sacerdotes as suas tarefas e os encorajou a fazer o seu trabalho no templo {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.

decisions.choice: their duties: the posts each group of priests kept in turn
decisions.reason: The word means a watch or charge. The priests served by divisions, each with its own turn of duty (1 Chronicles 24:1-19; 2 Chronicles 8:14; 31:2). Josiah put each group back in its place.

decisions.choice: strengthened them: encouraged them
decisions.reason: The verb means to make strong. Said of people it means to put heart into them, as Hezekiah did for his officers (32:6-7) and David for Solomon (1 Chronicles 22:13).

decisions.choice: temple
decisions.reason: Readable says "temple" for "the house of the LORD", the plain word for the building.

decisions.choice: os fortaleceu (L); os animou (B); os encorajou (R)
decisions.reason: The verb "make strong", said of people, means putting heart into them (m2): Literal keeps "fortalecer", and Balanced and Readable say "animar" and "encorajar", as the English says "urged on" and "encouraged".

source.text: וַיֹּ֣אמֶר לַ֠לְוִיִּם הַמְּבִינִ֨ים לְכָל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל הַקְּדוֹשִׁ֣ים לַיהוָ֗ה תְּנ֤וּ אֶת־אֲרוֹן־הַקֹּ֨דֶשׁ֙ בַּ֠בַּיִת אֲשֶׁ֨ר בָּנָ֜ה שְׁלֹמֹ֤ה בֶן־דָּוִיד֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל אֵין־לָכֶ֥ם מַשָּׂ֖א בַּכָּתֵ֑ף עַתָּ֗ה עִבְדוּ֙ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיכֶ֔ם וְאֵ֖ת עַמּ֥וֹ יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

records.literal_gloss: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, the holy [ones] to Yahweh, Put [the] ark of the holiness in the house which built Solomon son of David king of Israel; there [is] no for you burden on the shoulder; now serve Yahweh your God and his people Israel.

en.L: And he said to the Levites who taught all Israel, who [were] holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon son of David king of Israel built. There [is] no burden for you on the shoulder. Now serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel.
en.B: He said to the Levites, who taught all Israel and who were holy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, "Put the holy ark in the house that Solomon son of David, king of Israel, built. You do not need to carry it on your shoulders. Serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God now, and serve {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel.
en.R: Josiah spoke to the Levites. They taught all the people of Israel, and they had been set apart for {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. He said, "Put the holy ark in the temple that Solomon son of David, king of Israel, built. You do not have to carry it on your shoulders anymore. Now serve {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} your God and serve {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people Israel.

es.L: Y dijo a los levitas que enseñaban a todo Israel, los consagrados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} el arca santa en la casa que edificó Salomón hijo de David, rey de Israel. No [tienen] {{plural_you:ustedes|vosotros}} carga sobre el hombro. Ahora {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel.
es.B: Dijo a los levitas, que enseñaban a todo Israel y estaban consagrados {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}: «{{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} el arca santa en la casa que edificó Salomón hijo de David, rey de Israel. Ya no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que llevarla sobre los hombros. {{plural_you:Sirvan|Servid}} ahora {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios y a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel.
es.R: Josías habló a los levitas. Ellos enseñaban a todo el pueblo de Israel y habían sido apartados para {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}. Les dijo: «{{plural_you:Pongan|Poned}} el arca santa en el templo que edificó Salomón hijo de David, rey de Israel. Ya no {{plural_you:tienen|tenéis}} que cargarla sobre los hombros. Ahora {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} {{plural_you:su|vuestro}} Dios y {{plural_you:sirvan|servid}} a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo Israel.

fr.L: Et il dit aux Lévites qui enseignaient tout Israël, qui [étaient] consacrés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Mettez l’arche sainte dans la maison qu’a bâtie Salomon fils de David, roi d’Israël. Vous n’avez plus de fardeau sur l’épaule. Maintenant, servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu et {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël.
fr.B: Il dit aux Lévites, qui enseignaient tout Israël et qui étaient consacrés {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} : « Mettez l’arche sainte dans la maison qu’a bâtie Salomon, fils de David, roi d’Israël. Vous n’avez plus à la porter sur vos épaules. Servez maintenant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu et servez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël.
fr.R: Josias a parlé aux Lévites. Ils enseignaient tout le peuple d’Israël, et ils avaient été mis à part pour {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}. Il leur a dit : « Mettez l’arche sainte dans le temple que Salomon, fils de David, roi d’Israël, a construit. Vous n’avez plus besoin de la porter sur vos épaules. Maintenant, servez {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} votre Dieu et servez {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple Israël.

sw.L: Akawaambia Walawi waliowafundisha Israeli wote, walio watakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Liwekeni sanduku takatifu katika nyumba aliyoijenga Sulemani mwana wa Daudi mfalme wa Israeli. Hamna mzigo begani. Sasa mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu na watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli.
sw.B: Aliwaambia Walawi, waliowafundisha Israeli wote na waliokuwa watakatifu kwa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, "Liwekeni sanduku takatifu katika nyumba aliyoijenga Sulemani mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli. Hamhitaji kulibeba mabegani. Sasa mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu, na kuwatumikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli.
sw.R: Yosia alizungumza na Walawi. Wao waliwafundisha watu wote wa Israeli, nao walikuwa wametengwa kwa ajili ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Akasema, "Liwekeni sanduku takatifu katika hekalu alilolijenga Sulemani mwana wa Daudi, mfalme wa Israeli. Hamhitaji tena kulibeba mabegani. Sasa mtumikieni {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wenu na kuwatumikia watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} Israeli.

vi.L: Vua nói với người Lê-vi, là những người dạy dỗ cả Y-sơ-ra-ên và là những người thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Hãy đặt hòm thánh trong nhà mà Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã xây. Các ngươi không còn gánh nặng trên vai nữa. Bây giờ hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của các ngươi, và Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Vua nói với người Lê-vi, là những người dạy dỗ cả Y-sơ-ra-ên và đã được biệt riêng ra thánh cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}: "Hãy đặt hòm thánh trong nhà mà Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã xây. Anh em không cần phải khiêng hòm trên vai nữa. Bây giờ hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, và phục vụ Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.R: Giô-si-a nói với người Lê-vi. Họ là những người dạy dỗ toàn dân Y-sơ-ra-ên và đã được biệt riêng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vua nói: "Hãy đặt hòm thánh trong đền thờ mà Sa-lô-môn con trai Đa-vít, vua Y-sơ-ra-ên, đã xây. Anh em không phải khiêng hòm trên vai nữa. Bây giờ hãy phục vụ {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đức Chúa Trời của anh em, và phục vụ Y-sơ-ra-ên, dân của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 온 이스라엘을 가르치며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 구별된 레위인들에게 말했다. "거룩한 궤를 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 아들 솔로몬이 지은 집에 두어라. 너희가 어깨에 멜 짐이 없다. 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}와 그분의 백성 이스라엘을 섬겨라.
ko.B: 그는 온 이스라엘을 가르치며 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 거룩하게 구별된 레위인들에게 말했다. "거룩한 궤를 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 아들 솔로몬이 지은 성전에 두어라. 너희는 더 이상 그것을 어깨에 메고 다닐 필요가 없다. 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기고, 그분의 백성 이스라엘을 섬겨라.
ko.R: 요시야가 레위인들에게 말했다. 레위인들은 이스라엘의 모든 백성을 가르쳤고, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 따로 구별된 사람들이었다. 요시야가 말했다. "거룩한 궤를 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 아들 솔로몬이 지은 성전에 두어라. 너희는 이제 그것을 어깨에 메고 다니지 않아도 된다. 이제 너희 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 섬기고, 그분의 백성 이스라엘을 섬겨라.

pt.L: E disse aos levitas que ensinavam todo o Israel, que [eram] santos {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Ponham a arca santa na casa que Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel, edificou. Não [há] para vocês carga sobre o ombro. Agora sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo Israel.
pt.B: Ele disse aos levitas, que ensinavam todo o Israel e que eram consagrados {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}: "Ponham a arca santa na casa que Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel, construiu. Vocês não precisam carregá-la nos ombros. Sirvam agora {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e sirvam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo Israel.
pt.R: Josias falou com os levitas. Eles ensinavam todo o povo de Israel e tinham sido separados para {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}. Ele disse: "Ponham a arca santa no templo que Salomão, filho de Davi, rei de Israel, construiu. Vocês não precisam mais carregá-la nos ombros. Agora sirvam {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o Deus de vocês, e sirvam o {{deity_pronoun:seu|Seu}} povo Israel.

decisions.choice: put the holy ark in the house: the ark is to stay in its place in the temple
alternatives: the ark had been removed by an earlier king
the ark had been moved for the repairs
leave the ark where it is
decisions.reason: Solomon had placed the ark in the inner room of the temple (5:7). The text does not say why it now needed to be put there. It may have been taken out under Manasseh or Amon, when other gods were worshiped in the temple (33:4-7), or moved during the repairs (34:8-13). Or the command may mean only that it is to stay where it is, so that the Levites are free for other work.

decisions.choice: no burden on the shoulder: the Levites no longer carry the ark
decisions.reason: In the wilderness the Levites carried the ark and the holy things on their shoulders (Numbers 4:15; 7:9; 1 Chronicles 15:15). David had said that once the ark had a resting place in Jerusalem the Levites would no longer need to carry it (1 Chronicles 23:25-26). With that task gone, Josiah gives them other work: serving Yahweh and his people at the Passover.

decisions.choice: who taught: the reading in the margin
decisions.reason: The written text has a rarer form of the verb; the reading in the margin of the Hebrew text has the usual participle, "who taught". Both mean the same. The Levites taught the law to the people, as in 17:8-9 and Nehemiah 8:7-9.

decisions.choice: the holy ones to Yahweh: the Levites themselves
decisions.reason: The words stand beside "the Levites" and describe them: they were set apart for Yahweh (Numbers 3:12-13; 8:14). They are not a separate group.

decisions.choice: You do not need to carry it on your shoulders (Balanced); anymore (Readable)
decisions.reason: Balanced turns "there is no burden for you on the shoulder" into a plain statement about carrying the ark. Readable adds "anymore", since the carrying belonged to the past (m2).

decisions.choice: the king's speech runs from here to the end of verse 6
decisions.reason: Josiah's words to the Levites go on through verses 4-6, so the quotation opens here and closes at the end of verse 6.

decisions.choice: plural_you through Josiah's words in verses 3-6
decisions.reason: The king speaks to all the Levites, so every "you" is plural, with "ustedes" by default and "vosotros" as the alternative; the quotation runs to the end of verse 6, as the English does.

decisions.choice: Josiah calls the Levites "các ngươi" (L), "anh em" (B, R)
decisions.reason: As Jehoshaphat and Hezekiah speaking to the people in this block; Hezekiah's "các con" followed his own "my sons" (29:11), which Josiah does not say.

decisions.choice: "hòm thánh"
decisions.reason: The Samuel note's "hòm" for the ark.

decisions.choice: Josiah speaks to the Levites in 해라체 through verse 6
decisions.reason: A king gives orders to the temple servants in the plain style, as Hezekiah does in chapters 29-30.

decisions.choice: vocês, o Deus de vocês (the king to the Levites); santos (L), consagrados (B), separados (R) ao SENHOR
decisions.reason: The king speaks to the Levites with "vocês", and "o Deus de vocês", as 2 Kings 23:21 has it, where "o seu Deus" could be read as the people's God or the king's. The Levites "holy to the LORD" (m4) are "santos" at Literal, "consagrados" at Balanced and "separados" at Readable, as the English says "set apart". The speech runs on to the end of verse 6.

records.literal_gloss: And be ready by [the] house of your fathers, by your divisions, by [the] writing of David king of Israel and by [the] document of Solomon his son.

en.L: And be ready by the houses of your fathers, by your divisions, according to the writing of David king of Israel and according to the document of Solomon his son.
en.B: Get yourselves ready by your families, in your divisions, following the written orders of David king of Israel and of his son Solomon.
en.R: Get ready in your family groups and divisions, as David king of Israel and his son Solomon wrote down.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:prepárense|preparaos}} según las casas de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres, según {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} turnos, conforme a lo escrito por David rey de Israel y conforme a lo escrito por Salomón su hijo.
es.B: {{plural_you:Prepárense|Preparaos}} por familias, según {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} turnos, siguiendo las instrucciones escritas de David rey de Israel y de su hijo Salomón.
es.R: {{plural_you:Prepárense|Preparaos}} por grupos de familias y por turnos, como lo dejaron escrito David rey de Israel y su hijo Salomón.

fr.L: Et tenez-vous prêts selon les maisons de vos pères, selon vos classes, d’après l’écrit de David, roi d’Israël, et d’après le document de Salomon son fils.
fr.B: Préparez-vous par familles, selon vos classes, en suivant les instructions écrites de David, roi d’Israël, et de son fils Salomon.
fr.R: Préparez-vous par groupes de familles et par classes, comme David, roi d’Israël, et son fils Salomon l’ont mis par écrit.

sw.L: Jiwekeni tayari kwa nyumba za baba zenu, kwa zamu zenu, sawasawa na maandishi ya Daudi mfalme wa Israeli na sawasawa na maandishi ya Sulemani mwanawe.
sw.B: Jiandaeni kwa jamaa zenu, katika zamu zenu, mkifuata maagizo yaliyoandikwa na Daudi mfalme wa Israeli na mwanawe Sulemani.
sw.R: Jiandaeni katika vikundi vya jamaa zenu na zamu zenu, kama Daudi mfalme wa Israeli na mwanawe Sulemani walivyoandika.

vi.L: Hãy chuẩn bị theo gia tộc của các ngươi, theo các ban của các ngươi, theo văn bản của Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và theo văn thư của Sa-lô-môn con trai người.
vi.B: Hãy chuẩn bị theo gia tộc, theo ban thứ của anh em, đúng như những lệnh đã viết của Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và của Sa-lô-môn con trai người.
vi.R: Hãy chuẩn bị theo gia đình và theo ban thứ của anh em, như Đa-vít vua Y-sơ-ra-ên và Sa-lô-môn con trai người đã viết ra.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 왕 다윗의 글과 그의 아들 솔로몬의 문서대로, 너희 조상의 집별로, 너희 반열별로 준비하여라.
ko.B: 이스라엘 왕 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬이 글로 써서 남긴 지시에 따라, 가문별로, 반열별로 준비하여라.
ko.R: 이스라엘 왕 다윗과 그의 아들 솔로몬이 글로 적어 둔 대로, 집안별로, 무리별로 준비하여라.

pt.L: E preparem-se segundo as casas dos pais de vocês, segundo as suas turmas, conforme o escrito de Davi, rei de Israel, e conforme o documento de Salomão, o seu filho.
pt.B: Preparem-se por famílias, nas suas turmas, conforme as instruções escritas de Davi, rei de Israel, e do seu filho Salomão.
pt.R: Preparem-se em grupos de famílias e em turmas, como Davi, rei de Israel, e o seu filho Salomão deixaram escrito.

decisions.choice: the writing of David and of Solomon: the order of the Levites set down under them
decisions.reason: David divided the Levites into groups for their work (1 Chronicles 23-26), and Solomon set them in their duties by that order (8:14). Chronicles speaks of it as something written down, so that later kings could follow it (compare 29:25).

decisions.choice: be ready: the reading in the margin
decisions.reason: The written text has "prepare"; the reading in the margin has "be ready" or "make yourselves ready". The sense is the same: the Levites are to take their places by families and divisions.

decisions.choice: the house of your fathers: your family line
decisions.reason: A "father's house" is a family group traced from a common ancestor, the unit by which the Levites were counted and served (1 Chronicles 24:4-6).

decisions.choice: houses of your fathers (Literal); families (Balanced); family groups (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for "house of fathers" since Numbers.

decisions.choice: as casas dos pais de vocês (L), famílias (B), grupos de famílias (R); as turmas
decisions.reason: The father's house (m3) is "casa dos pais" at Literal and "família" at Balanced and Readable, as 1:2 has it; the divisions are "as turmas", the word set for the priestly and levitical divisions in 1 Chronicles 24, which David's writing ordered (m1).

source.text: וְעִמְד֣וּ בַקֹּ֗דֶשׁ לִפְלֻגּוֹת֙ בֵּ֣ית הָֽאָב֔וֹת לַאֲחֵיכֶ֖ם בְּנֵ֣י הָעָ֑ם וַחֲלֻקַּ֥ת בֵּֽית־אָ֖ב לַלְוִיִּֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And stand in the holy [place] by [the] divisions of [the] house of the fathers of your brothers, [the] sons of the people, and a portion of a house of a father for the Levites.

en.L: And stand in the holy [place] by the divisions of the houses of the fathers of your brothers, the sons of the people, and a portion of a father's house of the Levites [for each].
en.B: Take your stand in the holy place, family division by family division of your fellow Israelites, the lay people, with a section of a Levite family for each.
en.R: Take your places in the holy place. For each group of families of the people, there must be a group from one of the Levite families.

es.L: Y {{plural_you:estén|estad}} en el lugar santo según los grupos de las casas de los padres de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos, los hijos del pueblo, y una parte de una casa paterna de los levitas [para cada uno].
es.B: {{plural_you:Ocupen|Ocupad}} {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} puestos en el lugar santo, grupo por grupo de las familias de {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos israelitas, la gente del pueblo, con una sección de una familia levita para cada uno.
es.R: {{plural_you:Pónganse|Poneos}} en {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} lugares en el lugar santo. Por cada grupo de familias del pueblo, tiene que haber un grupo de una de las familias levitas.

fr.L: Et tenez-vous dans le lieu saint selon les divisions des maisons des pères de vos frères, les fils du peuple, et une part de maison de père des Lévites [pour chacune].
fr.B: Tenez-vous dans le lieu saint, par divisions familiales de vos frères israélites, les gens du peuple, avec pour chacune une partie d’une famille de Lévites.
fr.R: Prenez vos places dans le lieu saint. Pour chaque groupe de familles du peuple, il faut un groupe d’une des familles de Lévites.

sw.L: Simameni katika patakatifu kwa zamu za nyumba za baba za ndugu zenu, wana wa watu, na sehemu ya nyumba ya baba ya Walawi [kwa kila mmoja].
sw.B: Simameni katika patakatifu, zamu kwa zamu za jamaa za ndugu zenu, watu wa kawaida, na sehemu ya jamaa ya Walawi kwa kila mmoja.
sw.R: Simameni mahali penu katika patakatifu. Kwa kila kikundi cha jamaa za watu lazima kuwe na kikundi kutoka mojawapo ya jamaa za Walawi.

vi.L: Hãy đứng trong nơi thánh theo các ban của các gia tộc của anh em các ngươi, là con cái của dân chúng, và một phần gia tộc của người Lê-vi [cho mỗi ban].
vi.B: Hãy đứng trong nơi thánh theo từng ban gia tộc của anh em mình là dân thường, mỗi ban có một phần gia tộc người Lê-vi phụ trách.
vi.R: Hãy đứng vào chỗ của mình trong nơi thánh. Mỗi nhóm gia đình của dân chúng phải có một nhóm thuộc một gia tộc Lê-vi phụ trách.

ko.L: 그리고 너희 형제들, 곧 백성의 자손의 조상의 집들의 반열을 따라 성소에 서고, [각각에] 레위인의 조상의 집 한 부분이 [있게 하여라].
ko.B: 너희 동족인 일반 백성의 가문 반열마다, 레위인의 가문 한 부분씩을 맡아 성소에 서라.
ko.R: 성소에서 각자 자리를 잡아라. 백성의 각 집안 무리마다 레위인 집안 한 무리씩 맡아라.

pt.L: E fiquem no lugar santo segundo as turmas das casas dos pais dos irmãos de vocês, os filhos do povo, e uma parte de uma família dos levitas [para cada uma].
pt.B: Tomem os seus lugares no lugar santo, por turmas das famílias dos seus compatriotas, o povo comum, com uma parte de uma família levita para cada turma.
pt.R: Ocupem os seus lugares no lugar santo. Para cada grupo de famílias do povo, deve haver um grupo de uma das famílias levitas.

decisions.choice: a portion of a Levite family for each lay division
alternatives: and the Levites by the divisions of their own families
decisions.reason: The last words are short and hard. They are most easily taken to mean that each division of the lay families was to have a part of a Levite family assigned to it, to kill and prepare its lambs (verse 6). They may also mean simply that the Levites were to stand in their own family divisions.

decisions.choice: the holy place: the temple courts
decisions.reason: Here the holy place is the area of the temple where the sacrifices were made, the courts around the altar, not the inner room.

decisions.choice: your brothers, the sons of the people: the Israelites who were not Levites
decisions.reason: "Brothers" means fellow Israelites. "The sons of the people" are the lay people, as distinct from the priests and Levites (verses 7, 12, 13).

decisions.choice: [for each] (Literal); for each (Balanced, Readable); your fellow Israelites (Balanced)
decisions.reason: All three levels follow m1 and say that each division had its Levites. Balanced says "your fellow Israelites" for "your brothers", since the families included women and children; Readable leaves the phrase to "the people".

decisions.choice: os irmãos de vocês, os filhos do povo (L); os seus compatriotas, o povo comum (B); o povo (R)
decisions.reason: "Brothers" are fellow Israelites (m3): Literal keeps "irmãos", and Balanced says "compatriotas", which takes in the whole families without a gender setting, as the English "fellow Israelites" has none. "Os filhos do povo" is "o povo comum" at Balanced, as 2 Kings 23:6 has it, since "leigos" is a church word.

source.text: וְשַׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וְהִתְקַדְּשׁוּ֙ וְהָכִ֣ינוּ לַאֲחֵיכֶ֔ם לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת כִּדְבַר־יְהוָ֖ה בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And slaughter the Passover, and consecrate yourselves, and prepare for your brothers, to do according to [the] word of Yahweh by [the] hand of Moses.

en.L: And slaughter the Passover [lamb], and consecrate yourselves, and prepare [it] for your brothers, to do according to the word of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} by the hand of Moses."
en.B: Slaughter the Passover lamb, consecrate yourselves, and prepare it for your fellow Israelites, so as to do what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said through Moses."
en.R: Make yourselves holy and kill the Passover lambs. Get them ready for your fellow Israelites. Do everything {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said through Moses."

es.L: Y {{plural_you:degüellen|degollad}} la Pascua [el cordero], y {{plural_you:santifíquense|santificaos}}, y {{plural_you:prepárenla|preparadla}} para {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos, para hacer conforme a la palabra {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} [dada] por mano de Moisés».
es.B: {{plural_you:Degüellen|Degollad}} el cordero de la Pascua, {{plural_you:santifíquense|santificaos}} y {{plural_you:prepárenlo|preparadlo}} para {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos israelitas, para cumplir lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo por medio de Moisés».
es.R: {{plural_you:Purifíquense|Purificaos}} y {{plural_you:maten|matad}} los corderos de la Pascua. {{plural_you:Prepárenlos|Preparadlos}} para {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} hermanos israelitas. {{plural_you:Hagan|Haced}} todo lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dijo por medio de Moisés».

fr.L: Et égorgez la Pâque, et consacrez-vous, et préparez-[la] pour vos frères, pour agir selon la parole {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} [donnée] par la main de Moïse. »
fr.B: Égorgez l’agneau de la Pâque, consacrez-vous et préparez-le pour vos frères israélites, afin de faire ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit par Moïse. »
fr.R: Rendez-vous saints et tuez les agneaux de la Pâque. Préparez-les pour vos frères israélites. Faites tout ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a dit par Moïse. »

sw.L: Mchinjeni [mwana-kondoo wa] Pasaka, mjitakase, mkawaandalie ndugu zenu, ili kufanya sawasawa na neno la {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa mkono wa Musa."
sw.B: Mchinjeni mwana-kondoo wa Pasaka, mjitakase, mkamwandae kwa ajili ya ndugu zenu Waisraeli, ili kufanya yale {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyosema kupitia Musa."
sw.R: Jifanyeni kuwa watakatifu, kisha mchinje wana-kondoo wa Pasaka. Waandalieni ndugu zenu Waisraeli. Fanyeni kila kitu ambacho {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema kupitia Musa."

vi.L: Hãy giết [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua, thánh hóa chính mình, và chuẩn bị [nó] cho anh em các ngươi, để làm theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [phán] qua tay Môi-se."
vi.B: Hãy giết chiên Lễ Vượt Qua, thánh hóa chính mình, và chuẩn bị chiên cho anh em mình, để làm theo lời {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Môi-se."
vi.R: Hãy làm cho mình nên thánh và giết chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua. Hãy chuẩn bị chiên cho anh em mình. Hãy làm mọi điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã phán qua Môi-se."

ko.L: 그리고 유월절 [양을] 잡고, 너희 자신을 거룩하게 하고, 너희 형제들을 위해 [그것을] 준비하여, 모세의 손으로 [주신] {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 말씀대로 행하여라."
ko.B: 유월절 양을 잡고, 너희 자신을 거룩하게 하고, 너희 동족을 위해 그것을 준비하여, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통해 하신 말씀대로 행하여라."
ko.R: 너희 자신을 거룩하게 하고 유월절 양을 잡아라. 그것을 너희 동족을 위해 준비하여라. {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통해 하신 말씀대로 모두 행하여라."

pt.L: E abatam a Páscoa, e consagrem-se, e [a] preparem para os irmãos de vocês, para fazerem conforme a palavra {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} pela mão de Moisés."
pt.B: Abatam o cordeiro da Páscoa, consagrem-se e preparem-no para os seus compatriotas, para fazerem o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse por meio de Moisés."
pt.R: Santifiquem-se e matem os cordeiros da Páscoa. Preparem os cordeiros para os seus compatriotas. Façam tudo o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} disse por meio de Moisés."

decisions.choice: slaughter ... consecrate yourselves: two parts of one duty, not steps in order
decisions.reason: The Levites had to be ritually clean to handle the sacrifices, so "consecrate yourselves" cannot mean that they made themselves clean only after the killing. The two commands name the whole of what they must do. At Hezekiah's Passover the Levites killed the lambs for those who were not clean (30:17).

decisions.choice: by the hand of Moses: through Moses
decisions.reason: The word of Yahweh came to the people through Moses as his spokesman. The Passover laws are in Exodus 12 and Deuteronomy 16:1-8.

decisions.choice: your brothers: the lay Israelites
decisions.reason: As in verse 5, the brothers are the people of Israel, for whom the Levites prepare the Passover.

decisions.choice: Make yourselves holy and kill
decisions.reason: Readable puts the cleansing first so that it does not read as coming after the killing (m1).

decisions.choice: abatam (L, B), matem (R); consagrem-se (L, B), santifiquem-se (R)
decisions.reason: The verbs keep the words 30:15 and 30:17 give the same acts in Portuguese, "abater" and "consagrar-se" at Literal and Balanced, "matar" and "santificar-se" at Readable, where the cleansing comes first, as the English Readable has it (m1). The king's speech closes here.

source.text: וַיָּ֣רֶם יֹאשִׁיָּ֣הוּ לִבְנֵ֪י הָעָ֟ם צֹ֞אן כְּבָשִׂ֣ים וּבְנֵֽי־עִזִּים֮ הַכֹּ֣ל לַפְּסָחִים֒ לְכָל־הַנִּמְצָ֗א לְמִסְפַּר֙ שְׁלֹשִׁ֣ים אֶ֔לֶף וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֑ים אֵ֖לֶּה מֵרְכ֥וּשׁ הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And contributed Josiah to [the] sons of the people flock, lambs and young [ones] of goats, all for the Passovers, for all the [one] found, to [the] number of thirty thousand, and cattle three thousand; these [were] from [the] property of the king.

en.L: And Josiah contributed to the sons of the people [animals of the] flock, lambs and young goats, all for the Passover offerings, for all who were present, to the number of 30,000, and 3,000 cattle; these [were] from the king's property.
en.B: Josiah gave the lay people animals from the flock, lambs and young goats, all for the Passover offerings for everyone who was there, 30,000 in number, and 3,000 cattle. These came from the king's own property.
en.R: For all the people who were there, Josiah gave 30,000 lambs and young goats for the Passover offerings, and 3,000 cattle. All these came from what the king owned.

es.L: Y Josías dio a los hijos del pueblo [animales del] rebaño, corderos y cabritos, todo para las pascuas, para todos los que se hallaban [allí], en número de treinta mil, y tres mil bueyes; esto [era] de los bienes del rey.
es.B: Josías dio a la gente del pueblo animales del rebaño, corderos y cabritos, todos para las ofrendas de la Pascua de todos los que estaban allí, en total treinta mil, y además tres mil bueyes. Todo esto salió de los bienes propios del rey.
es.R: Para toda la gente que estaba allí, Josías dio treinta mil corderos y cabritos para las ofrendas de la Pascua, y tres mil bueyes. Todo esto era de lo que el rey poseía.

fr.L: Et Josias préleva pour les fils du peuple du petit bétail, des agneaux et des chevreaux, le tout pour les [sacrifices de la] Pâque, pour tous ceux qui se trouvaient là, au nombre de trente mille, et trois mille bœufs ; cela [venait] des biens du roi.
fr.B: Josias donna aux gens du peuple du petit bétail, des agneaux et des chevreaux, le tout pour les sacrifices de la Pâque de tous ceux qui étaient présents, au nombre de trente mille, ainsi que trois mille bœufs. Tout cela venait des biens du roi.
fr.R: Pour tous les gens qui étaient là, Josias a donné trente mille agneaux et chevreaux pour les sacrifices de la Pâque, et trois mille bœufs. Tout cela venait de ce que le roi possédait.

sw.L: Naye Yosia akawapa wana wa watu [wanyama wa] kundi, wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi, wote kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka, kwa ajili ya wote waliokuwapo, kwa hesabu ya 30,000, na ng'ombe 3,000; hawa [walikuwa] mali ya mfalme.
sw.B: Yosia aliwapa watu wa kawaida wanyama wa kundi, wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi, wote kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka kwa kila mtu aliyekuwapo, jumla yao 30,000, pamoja na ng'ombe 3,000. Hawa walitoka katika mali ya mfalme mwenyewe.
sw.R: Kwa ajili ya watu wote waliokuwapo, Yosia alitoa wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi 30,000 kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka, na ng'ombe 3,000. Wote hawa walitoka katika mali ya mfalme.

vi.L: Giô-si-a ban cho con cái của dân chúng [những con vật trong] bầy, chiên con và dê con, tất cả để làm Lễ Vượt Qua cho mọi người có mặt, số là ba mươi nghìn con, cùng ba nghìn con bò; các con vật ấy [lấy] từ tài sản của vua.
vi.B: Giô-si-a ban cho dân thường những con vật trong bầy, chiên con và dê con, tất cả để làm Lễ Vượt Qua cho mọi người có mặt, tổng cộng 30.000 con, cùng 3.000 con bò. Những con vật này lấy từ tài sản riêng của vua.
vi.R: Giô-si-a ban cho mọi người có mặt 30.000 chiên con và dê con để làm Lễ Vượt Qua, cùng 3.000 con bò. Tất cả đều lấy từ tài sản của vua.

ko.L: 그리고 요시야가 백성의 자손에게, 그곳에 있는 모든 사람을 위한 유월절 제물로, 양 떼, 곧 어린 양과 어린 염소를 30,000마리와 소 3,000마리를 내놓았다. 이것은 왕의 재산에서 [나온 것이었다].
ko.B: 요시야는 그곳에 있는 모든 백성에게 유월절 제물로 쓸 양 떼, 곧 어린 양과 어린 염소 30,000마리와 소 3,000마리를 내주었다. 이것은 모두 왕의 재산에서 나온 것이었다.
ko.R: 요시야는 그곳에 모인 모든 백성에게 유월절 제물로 쓸 어린 양과 어린 염소 30,000마리와 소 3,000마리를 주었다. 이것은 모두 왕이 가진 것에서 나왔다.

pt.L: E Josias contribuiu para os filhos do povo [com animais do] rebanho, cordeiros e cabritos, tudo para as [ofertas da] Páscoa, para todos os que se achavam [ali], em número de trinta mil, e três mil bois; estes [eram] dos bens do rei.
pt.B: Josias deu ao povo comum animais do rebanho, cordeiros e cabritos, todos para as ofertas da Páscoa de todos os que estavam ali, trinta mil ao todo, e três mil bois. Tudo isso era dos bens do próprio rei.
pt.R: Para todo o povo que estava ali, Josias deu trinta mil cordeiros e cabritos para as ofertas da Páscoa, e três mil bois. Tudo isso era do próprio rei.

decisions.choice: contributed: set apart as a gift
decisions.reason: The verb means to lift up, and is used for setting something apart from one's own goods as an offering (Numbers 15:19-20; 2 Chronicles 30:24).

decisions.choice: cattle: for the other offerings of the festival
decisions.reason: The Passover animal itself was a lamb or a young goat (Exodus 12:5). The cattle were for the other sacrifices of the festival week, the burnt offerings and the holy offerings that were boiled and eaten (verses 12-13).

decisions.choice: the king gives from his own goods, as Hezekiah had
decisions.reason: Hezekiah gave 1,000 bulls and 7,000 sheep for his Passover, and his officials gave more (30:24). Josiah's gift is far larger. Kings also gave from their own herds for the regular offerings (31:3).
Numbers above ninety-nine are written as numerals at every level.

decisions.choice: "trente mille", "trois mille" in words
decisions.reason: French writes round thousands in words, as French Kings does ("dix mille"); the English writes numerals above ninety-nine.

decisions.choice: contribuiu (L), deu (B, R); trinta mil, três mil (in words); bois
decisions.reason: "Contribuir" is the Portuguese of 30:24 for the same verb of setting apart a gift (m1, m3). Round numbers are written in words, as 30:24 does, where the English gives figures. The cattle are "bois", the plain word for the herd animal, where 30:24 has "novilhos" for a different word, bulls.

source.text: וְשָׂרָ֞יו לִנְדָבָ֥ה לָעָ֛ם לַכֹּהֲנִ֥ים וְלַלְוִיִּ֖ם הֵרִ֑ימוּ חִלְקִיָּ֨ה וּזְכַרְיָ֜הוּ וִֽיחִיאֵ֗ל נְגִידֵי֙ בֵּ֣ית הָאֱלֹהִ֔ים לַכֹּהֲנִ֞ים נָתְנ֣וּ לַפְּסָחִ֗ים אַלְפַּ֨יִם֙ וְשֵׁ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וּבָקָ֖ר שְׁלֹ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And his princes for a freewill offering to the people, to the priests and to the Levites contributed; Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of [the] house of God, to the priests gave for the Passovers two thousand and six hundred, and cattle three hundred.

en.L: And his princes contributed as a freewill offering to the people, to the priests and to the Levites. Hilkiah and Zechariah and Jehiel, rulers of the house of God, gave to the priests for the Passover offerings 2,600 and 300 cattle.
en.B: His officials also gave freely to the people, the priests and the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, the chief officers of the house of God, gave 2,600 Passover offerings and 300 cattle to the priests.
en.R: The king's leaders also gave gifts of their own free will to the people, the priests and the Levites. Hilkiah, Zechariah and Jehiel, who were in charge of God's temple, gave the priests 2,600 lambs and goats for the Passover, and 300 cattle.

es.L: Y sus príncipes dieron ofrenda voluntaria al pueblo, a los sacerdotes y a los levitas. Hilcías, y Zacarías, y Jehiel, jefes de la casa de Dios, dieron a los sacerdotes para las pascuas dos mil seiscientas [reses] y trescientos bueyes.
es.B: Sus jefes también dieron ofrendas voluntarias al pueblo, a los sacerdotes y a los levitas. Hilcías, Zacarías y Jehiel, los encargados principales de la casa de Dios, dieron a los sacerdotes dos mil seiscientas ofrendas para la Pascua y trescientos bueyes.
es.R: Los dirigentes del rey también dieron regalos voluntarios al pueblo, a los sacerdotes y a los levitas. Hilcías, Zacarías y Jehiel, que estaban a cargo del templo de Dios, dieron a los sacerdotes dos mil seiscientos corderos y cabritos para la Pascua, y trescientos bueyes.

fr.L: Et ses princes firent des dons volontaires au peuple, aux prêtres et aux Lévites. Hilqiya, et Zacharie, et Yehiel, chefs de la maison de Dieu, donnèrent aux prêtres, pour les [sacrifices de la] Pâque, deux mille six cents [agneaux] et trois cents bœufs.
fr.B: Ses chefs firent aussi des dons volontaires au peuple, aux prêtres et aux Lévites. Hilqiya, Zacharie et Yehiel, les responsables de la maison de Dieu, donnèrent aux prêtres deux mille six cents agneaux pour la Pâque et trois cents bœufs.
fr.R: Les chefs du roi ont aussi fait des dons, de leur plein gré, au peuple, aux prêtres et aux Lévites. Hilqiya, Zacharie et Yehiel, qui dirigeaient le temple de Dieu, ont donné aux prêtres deux mille six cents agneaux et chevreaux pour la Pâque, et trois cents bœufs.

sw.L: Na wakuu wake wakatoa sadaka ya hiari kwa watu, kwa makuhani na kwa Walawi. Hilkia na Zekaria na Yehieli, wakuu wa nyumba ya Mungu, wakawapa makuhani kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka 2,600 na ng'ombe 300.
sw.B: Maafisa wake nao walitoa kwa hiari kwa watu, makuhani na Walawi. Hilkia, Zekaria na Yehieli, wasimamizi wakuu wa nyumba ya Mungu, waliwapa makuhani sadaka za Pasaka 2,600 na ng'ombe 300.
sw.R: Viongozi wa mfalme nao walitoa zawadi kwa hiari yao kwa watu, makuhani na Walawi. Hilkia, Zekaria na Yehieli, waliosimamia hekalu la Mungu, waliwapa makuhani wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi 2,600 kwa ajili ya Pasaka, na ng'ombe 300.

vi.L: Các thủ lĩnh của vua cũng dâng lễ vật tự nguyện cho dân chúng, cho các thầy tế lễ và cho người Lê-vi. Hinh-kia, Xa-cha-ri và Giê-hi-ên, những người cai quản nhà Đức Chúa Trời, ban cho các thầy tế lễ để làm Lễ Vượt Qua hai nghìn sáu trăm [con], cùng ba trăm con bò.
vi.B: Các quan chức của vua cũng tự nguyện dâng cho dân chúng, các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi. Hinh-kia, Xa-cha-ri và Giê-hi-ên, những người coi sóc nhà Đức Chúa Trời, ban cho các thầy tế lễ 2.600 con vật làm Lễ Vượt Qua và ba trăm con bò.
vi.R: Các người lãnh đạo của vua cũng tự nguyện ban tặng cho dân chúng, các thầy tế lễ và người Lê-vi. Hinh-kia, Xa-cha-ri và Giê-hi-ên, những người trông coi đền thờ Đức Chúa Trời, ban cho các thầy tế lễ 2.600 chiên dê để làm Lễ Vượt Qua và ba trăm con bò.

ko.L: 그리고 그의 지도자들이 백성과 제사장들과 레위인들에게 자원 예물로 내놓았다. 하나님의 집의 책임자들인 힐기야와 스가랴와 여히엘은 제사장들에게 유월절 제물로 2,600마리와 소 300마리를 주었다.
ko.B: 그의 관리들도 백성과 제사장들과 레위인들에게 자원하여 예물을 내주었다. 하나님의 집의 책임자들인 힐기야와 스가랴와 여히엘은 제사장들에게 유월절 제물 2,600마리와 소 300마리를 주었다.
ko.R: 왕의 지도자들도 백성과 제사장들과 레위인들에게 스스로 원해서 예물을 주었다. 하나님의 성전을 맡은 힐기야와 스가랴와 여히엘은 제사장들에게 유월절에 쓸 양과 염소 2,600마리와 소 300마리를 주었다.

pt.L: E os seus príncipes contribuíram com oferta voluntária para o povo, para os sacerdotes e para os levitas. Hilquias, e Zacarias, e Jeiel, chefes da casa de Deus, deram aos sacerdotes para as [ofertas da] Páscoa dois mil e seiscentos [animais] e trezentos bois.
pt.B: Os oficiais do rei também deram ofertas voluntárias ao povo, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas. Hilquias, Zacarias e Jeiel, os oficiais encarregados da casa de Deus, deram aos sacerdotes dois mil e seiscentos animais para as ofertas da Páscoa e trezentos bois.
pt.R: Os líderes do rei também deram presentes por vontade própria ao povo, aos sacerdotes e aos levitas. Hilquias, Zacarias e Jeiel, que eram os responsáveis pelo templo de Deus, deram aos sacerdotes dois mil e seiscentos cordeiros e cabritos para a Páscoa, e trezentos bois.

decisions.choice: his princes: the king's officials
decisions.reason: The leaders of the king's court followed his lead with gifts of their own. The next names, priests in charge of the temple, may be a group among them or a separate group.

decisions.choice: freewill offering: a gift no law required
decisions.reason: A freewill offering was given by choice, not to pay a vow or meet a rule (Leviticus 22:18-23; Deuteronomy 16:10).

decisions.choice: Hilkiah: the high priest; rulers of the house of God: the chief priests in charge of the temple
decisions.reason: Hilkiah was the high priest who found the book of the law (34:9, 14; 2 Kings 22:4, 8). The title "ruler of the house of God" is given to the chief priest in 1 Chronicles 9:11 and 2 Chronicles 31:13. Zechariah and Jehiel are not named elsewhere.

decisions.choice: princes / officials / leaders; rulers (Literal); chief officers (Balanced); were in charge (Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for officials (sar) in these books. The temple title is worded as in 1 Chronicles 9:11 and 31:13: Literal keeps "rulers"; Balanced and Readable say what the men did, since "ruler" alone would suggest a king.

decisions.choice: lambs and goats
decisions.reason: Readable names the Passover animals, as verse 7 does.

decisions.choice: príncipes (L), oficiais (B), líderes (R); oferta voluntária; chefes da casa de Deus (L), os oficiais encarregados da casa de Deus (B), os responsáveis pelo templo de Deus (R)
decisions.reason: The officials keep the words 30:24 gives them at each level (m1); the freewill offering (m2) is "oferta voluntária", the Pentateuch's term. The temple title (m3) keeps the Portuguese of 1 Chronicles 9:11 at each level. "Hilquias" is the high priest of 34:9; "Zacarias" and "Jeiel" are the usual Brazilian forms.

source.text: וְ֠כָֽנַנְיָהוּ וּשְׁמַֽעְיָ֨הוּ וּנְתַנְאֵ֜ל אֶחָ֗יו וַחֲשַׁבְיָ֧הוּ וִיעִיאֵ֛ל וְיוֹזָבָ֖ד שָׂרֵ֣י הַלְוִיִּ֑ם הֵרִ֨ימוּ לַלְוִיִּ֤ם לַפְּסָחִים֙ חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת אֲלָפִ֔ים וּבָקָ֖ר חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵאֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And Conaniah and Shemaiah and Nethanel his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, princes of the Levites, contributed to the Levites for the Passovers five thousand, and cattle five hundred.

en.L: And Conaniah, and Shemaiah and Nethanel his brothers, and Hashabiah and Jeiel and Jozabad, princes of the Levites, contributed to the Levites for the Passover offerings 5,000 and 500 cattle.
en.B: Conaniah, with his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad, the leaders of the Levites, gave the Levites 5,000 Passover offerings and 500 cattle.
en.R: The leaders of the Levites gave the Levites 5,000 lambs and goats for the Passover, and 500 cattle. These leaders were Conaniah and his brothers Shemaiah and Nethanel, and Hashabiah, Jeiel and Jozabad.

es.L: Y Conanías, y Semaías y Natanael sus hermanos, y Hasabías, y Jeiel, y Jozabad, jefes de los levitas, dieron a los levitas para las pascuas cinco mil [reses] y quinientos bueyes.
es.B: Conanías, con sus hermanos Semaías y Natanael, y Hasabías, Jeiel y Jozabad, los jefes de los levitas, dieron a los levitas cinco mil ofrendas para la Pascua y quinientos bueyes.
es.R: Los dirigentes de los levitas dieron a los levitas cinco mil corderos y cabritos para la Pascua, y quinientos bueyes. Estos dirigentes eran Conanías y sus hermanos Semaías y Natanael, y Hasabías, Jeiel y Jozabad.

fr.L: Et Konania, et Shemaya et Netanel, ses frères, et Hashabia, et Yeïel, et Yozabad, chefs des Lévites, prélevèrent pour les Lévites, pour les [sacrifices de la] Pâque, cinq mille [agneaux] et cinq cents bœufs.
fr.B: Konania, avec ses frères Shemaya et Netanel, ainsi que Hashabia, Yeïel et Yozabad, les chefs des Lévites, donnèrent aux Lévites cinq mille agneaux pour la Pâque et cinq cents bœufs.
fr.R: Les chefs des Lévites ont donné aux Lévites cinq mille agneaux et chevreaux pour la Pâque, et cinq cents bœufs. Ces chefs étaient Konania et ses frères Shemaya et Netanel, ainsi que Hashabia, Yeïel et Yozabad.

sw.L: Na Konania, na Shemaya na Nethaneli ndugu zake, na Hashabia na Yeieli na Yozabadi, wakuu wa Walawi, wakawapa Walawi kwa ajili ya sadaka za Pasaka 5,000 na ng'ombe 500.
sw.B: Konania, pamoja na ndugu zake Shemaya na Nethaneli, na Hashabia, Yeieli na Yozabadi, viongozi wa Walawi, waliwapa Walawi sadaka za Pasaka 5,000 na ng'ombe 500.
sw.R: Viongozi wa Walawi waliwapa Walawi wana-kondoo na wana-mbuzi 5,000 kwa ajili ya Pasaka, na ng'ombe 500. Viongozi hao walikuwa Konania na ndugu zake Shemaya na Nethaneli, na Hashabia, Yeieli na Yozabadi.

vi.L: Cô-na-nia, Sê-ma-gia và Nê-tha-nê-ên, các anh em ông, cùng Ha-sa-bia, Giê-i-ên và Giô-xa-bát, các thủ lĩnh của người Lê-vi, ban cho người Lê-vi để làm Lễ Vượt Qua năm nghìn [con], cùng năm trăm con bò.
vi.B: Cô-na-nia cùng các anh em ông là Sê-ma-gia và Nê-tha-nê-ên, và Ha-sa-bia, Giê-i-ên và Giô-xa-bát, các người lãnh đạo người Lê-vi, ban cho người Lê-vi 5.000 con vật làm Lễ Vượt Qua và năm trăm con bò.
vi.R: Các người lãnh đạo người Lê-vi ban cho người Lê-vi 5.000 chiên dê để làm Lễ Vượt Qua và năm trăm con bò. Những người lãnh đạo ấy là Cô-na-nia và các anh em ông là Sê-ma-gia và Nê-tha-nê-ên, cùng Ha-sa-bia, Giê-i-ên và Giô-xa-bát.

ko.L: 그리고 고나냐와 그의 형제들 스마야와 느다넬과, 하사뱌와 여이엘과 요사바드, 곧 레위인들의 지도자들이 레위인들에게 유월절 제물로 5,000마리와 소 500마리를 내놓았다.
ko.B: 레위인들의 지도자들인 고나냐와 그의 형제 스마야와 느다넬과, 하사뱌와 여이엘과 요사바드는 레위인들에게 유월절 제물 5,000마리와 소 500마리를 내주었다.
ko.R: 레위인들의 지도자들은 레위인들에게 유월절에 쓸 양과 염소 5,000마리와 소 500마리를 주었다. 이 지도자들은 고나냐와 그의 형제 스마야와 느다넬, 그리고 하사뱌와 여이엘과 요사바드였다.

pt.L: E Conanias, e Semaías e Natanael, seus irmãos, e Hasabias, e Jeiel, e Jozabade, príncipes dos levitas, contribuíram para os levitas para as [ofertas da] Páscoa [com] cinco mil [animais] e quinhentos bois.
pt.B: Conanias, com os seus irmãos Semaías e Natanael, e Hasabias, Jeiel e Jozabade, os líderes dos levitas, deram aos levitas cinco mil animais para as ofertas da Páscoa e quinhentos bois.
pt.R: Os líderes dos levitas deram aos levitas cinco mil cordeiros e cabritos para a Páscoa, e quinhentos bois. Esses líderes eram Conanias e os seus irmãos Semaías e Natanael, e Hasabias, Jeiel e Jozabade.

decisions.choice: names also found under Hezekiah
decisions.reason: A Conaniah was in charge of the gifts in Hezekiah's time, with his brother Shimei, and a Shemaiah and a Jozabad served under him (31:12-15). These may be later members of the same families, since names were often handed down.

decisions.choice: Conaniah: the reading in the margin
decisions.reason: The written text and the reading in the margin differ by one letter in this name; both name the same man.

decisions.choice: the leaders of the Levites gave to the Levites
decisions.reason: Just as the king's officials gave to the priests, the chief Levites provided the animals the Levites needed for their own families and for the offerings they prepared.

decisions.choice: princes (Literal); leaders (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: The wording kept for sar; Balanced says "leaders" since these are heads of Levite families, not court officials. Readable names the gift first and the men after it, for a shorter sentence.

decisions.choice: "jefes" (L, B); "dirigentes" (R)
decisions.reason: Here the *sarim* are heads of Levite families, so Literal and Balanced say "jefes", as the English says "leaders". The names in their usual Spanish forms (Conanías, Semaías, Natanael, Hasabías, Jeiel, Jozabad).

decisions.choice: "Konania", "Netanel", "Hashabia"
decisions.reason: Names in the forms of these books, "Konania" as at 31:12.

decisions.choice: "các anh em ông"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew does not say who is older; "anh em" leaves it open, as Vietnamese can for a group of brothers.

decisions.choice: Conanias, Semaías, Natanael, Hasabias, Jeiel, Jozabade; príncipes (L), líderes (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Levites' names take their usual Brazilian forms, with "Jozabade" taking the final "-e" Portuguese adds after a consonant (m1); the same men may stand in 31:12-15, so other agents there should match these forms. "Príncipes" at Literal and "líderes" at Balanced and Readable, as the English, since these are heads of Levite families.

source.text: וַתִּכּ֖וֹן הָעֲבוֹדָ֑ה וַיַּֽעַמְד֨וּ הַכֹּהֲנִ֧ים עַל־עָמְדָ֛ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֥ם עַל־מַחְלְקוֹתָ֖ם כְּמִצְוַ֥ת הַמֶּֽלֶךְ׃

records.literal_gloss: And was prepared the service, and stood the priests at their place and the Levites at their divisions, according to [the] command of the king.

en.L: And the service was prepared, and the priests stood at their place, and the Levites by their divisions, according to the command of the king.
en.B: So the service was made ready. The priests took their places, and the Levites stood by their divisions, as the king had commanded.
en.R: When everything was ready for the service, the priests stood in their places, and the Levites stood in their groups, as the king had ordered.

es.L: Y fue preparado el servicio, y los sacerdotes estuvieron en su lugar, y los levitas en sus turnos, conforme al mandato del rey.
es.B: Así quedó preparado el servicio. Los sacerdotes ocuparon sus lugares, y los levitas se pusieron por turnos, como el rey había mandado.
es.R: Cuando todo estuvo listo para el servicio, los sacerdotes se pusieron en sus lugares, y los levitas en sus grupos, como el rey lo había ordenado.

fr.L: Et le service fut préparé, et les prêtres se tinrent à leur place, et les Lévites selon leurs classes, selon l’ordre du roi.
fr.B: Le service fut ainsi prêt. Les prêtres prirent leurs places, et les Lévites se tinrent selon leurs classes, comme le roi l’avait ordonné.
fr.R: Quand tout a été prêt pour le service, les prêtres se sont mis à leurs places, et les Lévites se sont tenus dans leurs groupes, comme le roi l’avait ordonné.

sw.L: Huduma ikaandaliwa, makuhani wakasimama mahali pao, na Walawi kwa zamu zao, sawasawa na amri ya mfalme.
sw.B: Basi huduma ikawa tayari. Makuhani walisimama mahali pao, na Walawi kwa zamu zao, kama mfalme alivyoamuru.
sw.R: Kila kitu kilipokuwa tayari kwa ajili ya ibada, makuhani walisimama mahali pao, na Walawi wakasimama katika vikundi vyao, kama mfalme alivyoagiza.

vi.L: Công việc được chuẩn bị xong; các thầy tế lễ đứng tại chỗ mình và người Lê-vi theo ban thứ mình, theo lệnh vua.
vi.B: Vậy công việc phục vụ đã sẵn sàng. Các thầy tế lễ đứng vào chỗ mình, và người Lê-vi đứng theo ban thứ mình, như vua đã truyền.
vi.R: Khi mọi việc đã sẵn sàng cho nghi lễ, các thầy tế lễ đứng vào chỗ của mình, và người Lê-vi đứng theo nhóm của mình, như vua đã ra lệnh.

ko.L: 그리고 섬김이 준비되자, 왕의 명령대로 제사장들은 그들의 자리에, 레위인들은 그들의 반열대로 섰다.
ko.B: 이렇게 하여 예배 준비가 갖추어졌다. 왕이 명령한 대로 제사장들은 제자리에 서고, 레위인들은 반열별로 섰다.
ko.R: 예배를 드릴 준비가 모두 되자, 왕이 명령한 대로 제사장들은 자기 자리에 섰고, 레위인들은 무리별로 섰다.

pt.L: E o serviço foi preparado, e os sacerdotes ficaram no seu lugar, e os levitas nas suas turmas, conforme a ordem do rei.
pt.B: Assim o serviço ficou pronto. Os sacerdotes tomaram os seus lugares, e os levitas ficaram nas suas turmas, como o rei tinha ordenado.
pt.R: Quando tudo estava pronto para o serviço, os sacerdotes ficaram nos seus lugares, e os levitas ficaram nos seus grupos, como o rei tinha mandado.

decisions.choice: the service: the work of the Passover sacrifice
decisions.reason: The word is used for the whole of the worship and work at the temple; here it is the killing, offering and cooking of the Passover told in verses 11-14. Verse 16 closes the account with the same words: "all the service of Yahweh was prepared".

decisions.choice: their place, their divisions: the places set for each group
decisions.reason: Each group had its own place and task: the priests at the altar, the Levites by their divisions among the people (verses 4-5).

decisions.choice: So
decisions.reason: Balanced opens with "So", since this verse follows from the orders and gifts of verses 3-9.

source.text: וַֽיִּשְׁחֲט֖וּ הַפָּ֑סַח וַיִּזְרְק֤וּ הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ מִיָּדָ֔ם וְהַלְוִיִּ֖ם מַפְשִׁיטִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And they slaughtered the Passover, and threw the priests from their hand, and the Levites [were] skinning.

en.L: And they slaughtered the Passover [lambs], and the priests threw [the blood received] from their hand, and the Levites [were] skinning [them].
en.B: They slaughtered the Passover lambs, and the priests splashed the blood they received from the Levites, while the Levites skinned the animals.
en.R: The Levites killed the Passover lambs and handed the blood to the priests, who splashed it on the altar. Meanwhile the Levites skinned the animals.

es.L: Y degollaron la Pascua, y los sacerdotes rociaban [la sangre recibida] de mano de ellos, y los levitas desollaban [los animales].
es.B: Degollaron los corderos de la Pascua, y los sacerdotes rociaban la sangre que recibían de los levitas, mientras los levitas desollaban los animales.
es.R: Los levitas mataron los corderos de la Pascua y les pasaron la sangre a los sacerdotes, que la rociaron sobre el altar. Mientras tanto, los levitas les quitaban la piel a los animales.

fr.L: Et ils égorgèrent la Pâque, et les prêtres répandaient [le sang reçu] de leur main, et les Lévites dépouillaient [les bêtes].
fr.B: On égorgea les agneaux de la Pâque, et les prêtres aspergeaient le sang qu’ils recevaient des Lévites, pendant que les Lévites dépouillaient les bêtes.
fr.R: Les Lévites ont tué les agneaux de la Pâque et ils ont passé le sang aux prêtres, qui l’ont aspergé sur l’autel. Pendant ce temps, les Lévites enlevaient la peau des bêtes.

sw.L: Wakachinja [wana-kondoo wa] Pasaka, nao makuhani wakanyunyiza [damu waliyopokea] kutoka mkononi mwao, nao Walawi [walikuwa] wakiwachuna ngozi.
sw.B: Waliwachinja wana-kondoo wa Pasaka, nao makuhani wakairushia madhabahu damu waliyopokea kutoka kwa Walawi, huku Walawi wakiwachuna ngozi wanyama hao.
sw.R: Walawi waliwachinja wana-kondoo wa Pasaka, wakawapa makuhani damu, nao makuhani wakaimwagia madhabahu. Wakati huo huo Walawi waliwachuna ngozi wanyama hao.

vi.L: Họ giết [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua, các thầy tế lễ rảy [máu nhận] từ tay họ, còn người Lê-vi lột da [chúng].
vi.B: Họ giết chiên Lễ Vượt Qua, các thầy tế lễ rảy máu nhận từ tay người Lê-vi, trong khi người Lê-vi lột da các con vật.
vi.R: Người Lê-vi giết chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua và trao máu cho các thầy tế lễ, và các thầy tế lễ rảy máu lên bàn thờ. Trong khi đó người Lê-vi lột da các con vật.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 유월절 [양을] 잡았고, 제사장들은 그들의 손에서 [받은 피를] 뿌렸으며, 레위인들은 [그것들의] 가죽을 벗겼다.
ko.B: 그들이 유월절 양을 잡자, 제사장들은 레위인들에게서 받은 피를 뿌렸고, 레위인들은 짐승의 가죽을 벗겼다.
ko.R: 레위인들이 유월절 양을 잡아 그 피를 제사장들에게 건네주면, 제사장들은 그 피를 제단에 뿌렸다. 그동안 레위인들은 짐승의 가죽을 벗겼다.

pt.L: E abateram a Páscoa, e os sacerdotes lançavam [o sangue recebido] da mão deles, e os levitas [estavam] tirando a pele [dos animais].
pt.B: Eles abateram os cordeiros da Páscoa, e os sacerdotes jogavam o sangue que recebiam dos levitas, enquanto os levitas tiravam a pele dos animais.
pt.R: Os levitas mataram os cordeiros da Páscoa e entregaram o sangue aos sacerdotes, que o jogaram no altar. Enquanto isso, os levitas tiravam a pele dos animais.

decisions.choice: they slaughtered: the Levites
decisions.reason: The subject is not named, but verse 6 gave the killing to the Levites, as at Hezekiah's Passover (30:17).

decisions.choice: threw from their hand: the blood, taken from the Levites' hands
decisions.reason: The object is left unsaid, as often with this verb in sacrifice: the blood was thrown or splashed against the altar (Leviticus 1:5; 3:2). "Their hand" is the Levites' hand; 30:16 says it in full: "the priests threw the blood from the hand of the Levites".

decisions.choice: skinning: preparing the carcasses
decisions.reason: Skinning the animals was work the worshiper could do (Leviticus 1:6), but at Hezekiah's dedication the Levites helped the priests with it when there were too many (29:34). Here they do it throughout.

decisions.choice: [the blood received] ... [them] (Literal); the blood, the animals (Balanced); the Levites, on the altar (Readable)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew leaves both objects unsaid. Each level supplies them, Literal in brackets; Readable also names the Levites as those who killed the lambs (m1) and the altar as where the blood went (m2).

decisions.choice: lançavam (L), jogavam (B), jogaram (R) [o sangue]; tirando a pele
decisions.reason: The priests' act keeps the words 30:16 gives it in Portuguese at each level, "lançar" (L) and "jogar" (B, R) the blood received from the Levites' hands (m2), with the unsaid objects bracketed at Literal, as the English does.

source.text: וַיָּסִ֨ירוּ הָעֹלָ֜ה לְ֠תִתָּם לְמִפְלַגּ֤וֹת לְבֵית־אָבוֹת֙ לִבְנֵ֣י הָעָ֔ם לְהַקְרִיב֙ לַיהוָ֔ה כַּכָּת֖וּב בְּסֵ֣פֶר מֹשֶׁ֑ה וְכֵ֖ן לַבָּקָֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: And they removed the burnt offering to give them to [the] divisions of [the] house of fathers of [the] sons of the people, to bring near to Yahweh as written in [the] book of Moses; and so for the cattle.

en.L: And they set aside the burnt offering, to give them to the divisions of the houses of [the] fathers of the sons of the people, to offer [them] to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as [it is] written in the book of Moses; and so [they did] with the cattle.
en.B: They set aside the burnt offerings to give them to the divisions of the families of the lay people, to offer to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, following what is written in the book of Moses. The cattle were handled in the same way.
en.R: They set aside the parts that were to be burned on the altar. They gave them to each group of families among the people, so that they could be offered to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, as the book of Moses says. They did the same with the cattle.

es.L: Y apartaron el holocausto para darlo a los grupos de las casas paternas de los hijos del pueblo, para ofrecer[lo] {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como [está] escrito en el libro de Moisés; y así [hicieron] con los bueyes.
es.B: Apartaron los holocaustos para darlos a los grupos de las familias de la gente del pueblo, para que los ofrecieran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como está escrito en el libro de Moisés. Lo mismo hicieron con los bueyes.
es.R: Apartaron las partes que se iban a quemar sobre el altar. Se las dieron a cada grupo de familias del pueblo, para que se ofrecieran {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, como lo dice el libro de Moisés. Hicieron lo mismo con los bueyes.

fr.L: Et ils mirent à part l’holocauste, pour le donner aux divisions des maisons des pères des fils du peuple, pour [l’]offrir {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme [il est] écrit dans le livre de Moïse ; et de même [pour] les bœufs.
fr.B: Ils mirent à part les holocaustes pour les donner aux divisions familiales des gens du peuple, afin qu’ils les offrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme il est écrit dans le livre de Moïse. On fit de même pour les bœufs.
fr.R: Ils ont mis à part les morceaux qui devaient être brûlés sur l’autel. Ils les ont donnés à chaque groupe de familles du peuple, pour qu’ils soient offerts {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, comme le dit le livre de Moïse. Ils ont fait la même chose avec les bœufs.

sw.L: Wakatenga sadaka ya kuteketezwa, ili kuzigawa kwa zamu za nyumba za baba za wana wa watu, kumtolea {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Musa; na vivyo hivyo [wakafanya] na ng'ombe.
sw.B: Walitenga sadaka za kuteketezwa ili kuzigawa kwa zamu za jamaa za watu wa kawaida, wamtolee {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama ilivyoandikwa katika kitabu cha Musa. Vivyo hivyo walifanya na ng'ombe.
sw.R: Walitenga sehemu zilizopaswa kuteketezwa juu ya madhabahu. Wakazigawa kwa kila kikundi cha jamaa za watu, ili zimtolewe {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, kama kitabu cha Musa kinavyosema. Walifanya vivyo hivyo na ng'ombe.

vi.L: Họ để riêng của lễ thiêu ra để giao cho các ban của các gia tộc của con cái dân chúng, để dâng [chúng] cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như [đã] chép trong sách Môi-se; và với bò cũng [làm] như vậy.
vi.B: Họ để riêng các phần dành làm của lễ thiêu ra để giao cho các ban gia tộc của dân thường, để dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, theo như đã chép trong sách Môi-se. Họ cũng làm như vậy với bò.
vi.R: Họ để riêng những phần sẽ được thiêu trên bàn thờ. Họ giao các phần ấy cho từng nhóm gia đình trong dân chúng để dâng lên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, như sách Môi-se dạy. Họ cũng làm như vậy với bò.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 번제물을 따로 떼어, 백성의 자손의 조상의 집들의 반열에게 주어서, 모세의 책에 기록된 대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리게 했다. 그리고 소도 그렇게 [했다].
ko.B: 그들은 번제물을 따로 떼어 일반 백성의 가문 반열들에게 나누어 주어, 모세의 책에 기록된 대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 드리게 했다. 소도 그렇게 했다.
ko.R: 그들은 제단에서 태워 바칠 부분들을 따로 떼어 놓았다. 그리고 그것을 백성의 각 집안 무리에게 나누어 주어, 모세의 책에 적힌 대로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 바치게 했다. 소도 그렇게 했다.

pt.L: E separaram o holocausto, para dá-los às turmas das casas dos pais dos filhos do povo, para [os] oferecerem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, como [está] escrito no livro de Moisés; e assim [fizeram] com os bois.
pt.B: Eles separaram os holocaustos para dá-los às turmas das famílias do povo comum, para que os oferecessem {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, conforme está escrito no livro de Moisés. E fizeram o mesmo com os bois.
pt.R: Eles separaram as partes que deviam ser queimadas no altar. Deram essas partes a cada grupo de famílias do povo, para que fossem oferecidas {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, como diz o livro de Moisés. Fizeram o mesmo com os bois.

decisions.choice: the burnt offering: the parts of the animals to be burned on the altar
alternatives: whole burnt offerings set apart from the gifts of verses 7-9
decisions.reason: The Passover lamb was eaten by the families, not burned whole. "The burnt offering" here seems to mean the parts that belonged to Yahweh and went up in smoke on the altar, such as the fat, as with peace offerings (Leviticus 3:3-5, 14-16). It may instead mean that some of the animals given were set aside as whole burnt offerings, which the people then presented.

decisions.choice: to give them ... to offer: the lay families present the portions
decisions.reason: The portions were handed to the lay families so that each family could bring its own part near to Yahweh, as the law has the worshiper bring the fat of the peace offering in his own hands (Leviticus 7:29-30).

decisions.choice: as written in the book of Moses: the laws of sacrifice
decisions.reason: The book of Moses is the law given through him; the rules for the parts burned on the altar are in Leviticus 3 and 7.

decisions.choice: the parts that were to be burned on the altar
decisions.reason: Readable explains what was set aside, following m1. If the other reading is right, Balanced "burnt offerings" still fits.

decisions.choice: o holocausto (L), os holocaustos (B); as partes que deviam ser queimadas no altar (R)
decisions.reason: "Holocausto" is the Old Testament term for the burnt offering, kept at Literal and Balanced, which leave open the two readings of m1; Readable follows the reading chosen there and says what was set aside, as the English does.

source.text: וַֽיְבַשְּׁל֥וּ הַפֶּ֛סַח בָּאֵ֖שׁ כַּמִּשְׁפָּ֑ט וְהַקֳּדָשִׁ֣ים בִּשְּׁל֗וּ בַּסִּיר֤וֹת וּבַדְּוָדִים֙ וּבַצֵּ֣לָח֔וֹת וַיָּרִ֖יצוּ לְכָל־בְּנֵ֥י הָעָֽם׃

records.literal_gloss: And they cooked the Passover in the fire according to the rule, and the holy [offerings] they cooked in pots and in kettles and in pans, and brought [them] quickly to all [the] sons of the people.

en.L: And they cooked the Passover [lambs] in the fire according to the rule, and the holy [offerings] they cooked in pots and in kettles and in pans, and brought [them] quickly to all the sons of the people.
en.B: They roasted the Passover lambs over the fire according to the rule, and they boiled the holy offerings in pots, kettles and pans and quickly brought them to all the lay people.
en.R: They roasted the Passover lambs over the fire, as the law required. They boiled the other holy offerings in pots, kettles and pans. Then they hurried to serve the meat to all the people.

es.L: Y cocieron la Pascua al fuego conforme a la norma, y las [ofrendas] santas las cocieron en ollas, y en calderos, y en sartenes, y [las] llevaron aprisa a todos los hijos del pueblo.
es.B: Asaron al fuego los corderos de la Pascua, conforme a la norma, y cocieron las ofrendas santas en ollas, calderos y sartenes, y las llevaron enseguida a toda la gente del pueblo.
es.R: Asaron al fuego los corderos de la Pascua, como lo mandaba la ley. Cocieron las demás ofrendas santas en ollas, calderos y sartenes. Luego se apresuraron a servir la carne a toda la gente.

fr.L: Et ils firent cuire la Pâque au feu selon la règle, et les [offrandes] saintes, ils les firent cuire dans des chaudrons, et dans des marmites, et dans des poêles, et ils [les] apportèrent en hâte à tous les fils du peuple.
fr.B: Ils firent rôtir les agneaux de la Pâque au feu selon la règle, et ils firent bouillir les offrandes saintes dans des chaudrons, des marmites et des poêles, puis ils les apportèrent en hâte à tous les gens du peuple.
fr.R: Ils ont fait rôtir les agneaux de la Pâque sur le feu, comme la loi le demandait. Ils ont fait bouillir les autres offrandes saintes dans des chaudrons, des marmites et des poêles. Puis ils se sont dépêchés de servir la viande à tout le peuple.

sw.L: Wakaipika Pasaka motoni sawasawa na agizo, na [sadaka] takatifu wakazipika katika vyungu na katika masufuria na katika vikaango, wakaziletea upesi wana wote wa watu.
sw.B: Waliwaoka wana-kondoo wa Pasaka motoni kulingana na agizo, wakazichemsha sadaka takatifu katika vyungu, masufuria na vikaango, wakawaletea upesi watu wote wa kawaida.
sw.R: Waliwaoka wana-kondoo wa Pasaka motoni, kama sheria ilivyotaka. Wakazichemsha sadaka nyingine takatifu katika vyungu, masufuria na vikaango. Kisha wakaharakisha kuwagawia watu wote nyama.

vi.L: Họ nấu [chiên] Lễ Vượt Qua trên lửa theo luật định, còn các [lễ vật] thánh thì họ nấu trong nồi, trong vạc và trong chảo, rồi mau chóng đem [đến] cho mọi con cái của dân chúng.
vi.B: Họ nướng chiên Lễ Vượt Qua trên lửa theo luật định, còn các lễ vật thánh thì họ luộc trong nồi, vạc và chảo, rồi mau chóng đem đến cho toàn dân.
vi.R: Họ nướng chiên con Lễ Vượt Qua trên lửa, như luật pháp đòi hỏi. Họ luộc các lễ vật thánh khác trong nồi, vạc và chảo. Rồi họ vội vàng đem thịt đến cho toàn dân.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 규례대로 유월절 [양을] 불에 익히고, 거룩한 [제물들은] 솥과 가마와 냄비에 익혀서, 모든 백성의 자손에게 빨리 가져다주었다.
ko.B: 그들은 규례대로 유월절 양을 불에 굽고, 거룩한 제물들은 솥과 가마와 냄비에 삶아서, 모든 백성에게 빨리 날라다 주었다.
ko.R: 그들은 율법에 정해진 대로 유월절 양을 불에 구웠다. 그리고 다른 거룩한 제물들은 솥과 가마와 냄비에 삶았다. 그런 다음 서둘러 그 고기를 모든 백성에게 날라다 주었다.

pt.L: E cozinharam a Páscoa no fogo, conforme a ordenança, e as [ofertas] santas cozinharam em panelas, e em caldeirões, e em tachos, e [as] levaram depressa a todos os filhos do povo.
pt.B: Assaram os cordeiros da Páscoa no fogo, conforme a ordenança, e cozinharam as ofertas santas em panelas, caldeirões e tachos, e as levaram depressa a todo o povo comum.
pt.R: Eles assaram os cordeiros da Páscoa no fogo, como a lei mandava. Cozinharam as outras ofertas santas em panelas, caldeirões e tachos. Depois serviram a carne depressa a todo o povo.

decisions.choice: cooked in the fire: roasted; cooked in pots: boiled
decisions.reason: The same verb is used twice. Its usual sense is to boil (1 Samuel 2:13-15), but it can mean to cook in general. Exodus 12:8-9 commands that the Passover lamb be roasted with fire and forbids eating it boiled in water, while Deuteronomy 16:7 says only "cook it". Here "in the fire, according to the rule" shows that the Passover lambs were roasted as Exodus requires, while the other holy offerings were boiled in pots, as was allowed for them (Leviticus 6:21; 1 Samuel 2:13-14). The verse uses the word of Deuteronomy in the sense of Exodus.

decisions.choice: according to the rule: Exodus 12:8-9
decisions.reason: The rule is the Passover law, which says how the lamb is to be cooked: roasted with fire, head, legs and inner parts together.

decisions.choice: the holy offerings: the other sacrifices eaten at the festival
decisions.reason: These are the sacrifices from the cattle and flocks given in verses 7-9, eaten by the worshipers, like peace offerings, during the festival.

decisions.choice: pots, kettles and pans: cooking vessels of different shapes
decisions.reason: The three words name kinds of cooking pots; their exact shapes are not known. The last is a broad, shallow dish (2 Kings 21:13).

decisions.choice: cooked ... cooked (Literal); roasted ... boiled (Balanced, Readable)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the one verb twice so the reader can see it. Balanced and Readable say what the verb means in each place (m1).

decisions.choice: the other holy offerings; serve the meat
decisions.reason: Readable says "other" to make clear the holy offerings are not the Passover lambs, and "serve the meat" for what was quickly brought.

decisions.choice: "cocieron ... cocieron" (L); "Asaron ... cocieron" (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the one verb twice so the reader can see it; Balanced and Readable say what it means in each place (m1), as the English does.

decisions.choice: wakaipika ... wakazipika
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the one Hebrew verb twice; Balanced and Readable say how each was cooked, roasting and boiling.

decisions.choice: "익히고 ... 익혀서" at Literal for the one Hebrew verb used twice
decisions.reason: Literal keeps one verb as the Hebrew does; Balanced and Readable say "roast" and "boil" (r-en-1).

decisions.choice: "nấu ... nấu" (L); "nướng ... luộc" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew uses one verb for both (m1); Literal keeps one Vietnamese verb, as the English Literal does.

decisions.choice: cozinharam ... cozinharam (L); assaram ... cozinharam (B, R)
decisions.reason: Literal keeps the one verb twice, as the English does, with "cozinhar", the word Deuteronomy 16:7 uses for it in Portuguese; Balanced and Readable say "assar" for the lamb, the word of Exodus 12:8-9 ("assado no fogo"), and "cozinhar" in pots for the other offerings (m1, m2).

decisions.choice: panelas, caldeirões e tachos
decisions.reason: The three cooking vessels (m4) are named with three plain Portuguese words, the last, "tachos", for a broad shallow pan; "frigideira" would suggest frying.

source.text: וְאַחַ֗ר הֵכִ֤ינוּ לָהֶם֙ וְלַכֹּ֣הֲנִ֔ים כִּ֤י הַכֹּהֲנִים֙ בְּנֵ֣י אַהֲרֹ֔ן בְּהַֽעֲל֛וֹת הָעוֹלָ֥ה וְהַחֲלָבִ֖ים עַד־לָ֑יְלָה וְהַלְוִיִּם֙ הֵכִ֣ינוּ לָהֶ֔ם וְלַכֹּהֲנִ֖ים בְּנֵ֥י אַהֲרֹֽן׃

records.literal_gloss: And afterward they prepared for themselves and for the priests, because the priests [the] sons of Aaron [were] in offering up the burnt offering and the fats until night; and the Levites prepared for themselves and for the priests [the] sons of Aaron.

en.L: And afterward they prepared [it] for themselves and for the priests, because the priests the sons of Aaron [were busy] offering up the burnt offering and the fat until night; so the Levites prepared [it] for themselves and for the priests the sons of Aaron.
en.B: Afterward they prepared it for themselves and the priests, since the priests, the sons of Aaron, were kept busy offering the burnt offerings and the fat until nightfall. So the Levites prepared it for themselves and for the priests, the sons of Aaron.
en.R: After that the Levites prepared the Passover for themselves and for the priests. The priests, Aaron's descendants, were busy until night offering the burnt offerings and burning the fat. That is why the Levites prepared the meal for themselves and for the priests.

es.L: Y después prepararon para sí y para los sacerdotes, porque los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón, [estaban ocupados] en ofrecer el holocausto y las grasas hasta la noche; por eso los levitas prepararon para sí y para los sacerdotes, hijos de Aarón.
es.B: Después la prepararon para ellos mismos y para los sacerdotes, porque los sacerdotes, los hijos de Aarón, estuvieron ocupados hasta la noche ofreciendo los holocaustos y la grasa. Por eso los levitas la prepararon para sí mismos y para los sacerdotes, los hijos de Aarón.
es.R: Después los levitas prepararon la Pascua para ellos mismos y para los sacerdotes. Los sacerdotes, descendientes de Aarón, estuvieron ocupados hasta la noche ofreciendo los holocaustos y quemando la grasa. Por eso los levitas prepararon la comida para ellos mismos y para los sacerdotes.

fr.L: Et ensuite ils [la] préparèrent pour eux-mêmes et pour les prêtres, car les prêtres, les fils d’Aaron, [furent occupés] à offrir l’holocauste et les graisses jusqu’à la nuit ; aussi les Lévites [la] préparèrent pour eux-mêmes et pour les prêtres, les fils d’Aaron.
